(☉ㅅ☉U)|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 20 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Fallen]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|...|Beginning of Wave 20 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fallen''' is a fast [[Enemies|enemy]] that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]], Fallen Arena [[PVP]] and [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] modes. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. This enemy has a decent amount of health and is noticeably much faster than most enemies that have spawned before it, including the [[Quick]], [[Breaker2]] and [[Invisible]]. The '''Fallen''' can be spawned by the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]], [[Fallen Reaper]] and [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]]. The [[Fallen Reaper]] can spawn the '''Fallen''' from wave 26 onwards. It could also be spawned by the former [[Nuclear Fallen King]]. The '''Fallen''' could have been spawned from the [[Mystery]] upon its death in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, from wave 21 onwards. ==Logbook Description== "''The Fallen were once ordinary citizens who lived within Paradise's borders. As magic began to fade, they swore an oath to defend their kingdom. They supplied the army with weapons, food, and clothing, keeping soldiers equipped and fed. Their society was built on strength and trust, and though they received basic training, they never expected to see combat. When the Queen's curse swept through their kingdom, it transformed these supporters into mindless soldiers.''" ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |The '''Fallen''' wears a turquoise T-shirt and grayish-white skin and has a slightly darker colored head and legs. It wears a white bandana around its head. It also has a sprinting animation. |Legacy |The '''Fallen''' wears a dark blue T-shirt and torsos that have patches of lighter color and black skin. It also has a sprinting animation. }} ==Strategy== *These enemies are strong and fast, and are quite a step up from the [[Fallen Squire]]. Cheap towers with high DPS are the best way to fend these enemies off, boosted by the [[DJ Booth]] and/or [[Commander]]. **Such towers include the [[Golden Cowboy]], [[Militant]], [[Engineer]] and [[Minigunner]]. **Higher level [[Military Base]]s can be quite strong against '''Fallens''' due to the [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] and [[Railgun Tank]]'s high health. *Slowing towers can be useful due to '''Fallen's''' speed. The [[Frost Blaster]], [[Cryomancer]] and [[Electroshocker]] are by far the most useful ones. **Some slowing towers like the [[Sledger]], [[Tesla]] or [[Frost Blaster]] can also be used to kill groups of '''Fallens''', due to their high damage and ability to hit multiple enemies. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants (Legacy)}} FallenPreOverhaul.png|First version, first animation (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Animations (Modern)}} FallenStunAnimation.gif|Current stun animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants (Modern)}} DefHacker1Fallen1.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1Fallen2.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Modern)}} CorpseFallenAnima2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseFallenAnima1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Legacy)}} CorpseLegacyFallen.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} EZMQJOFUMAQhUy1.jpg|'''Fallen''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Entity System - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen''' on a promotional video.
